page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports AVX and AVX-512F instructions. The hardware profile is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core) and a bundled 959 GB local SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.i2g.2xlarge generally falls into the lower tiers for raw compute and memory speed, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU performance ranking in the bottom 25%. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores are positioned in the bottom 25%. However, the server demonstrates moderate capability in specific areas, achieving average performance in Passmark CPU scores, Passmark CPU extended instructions, and large-block memory write bandwidth. Redis SET operations also perform at an average level, reaching 5.98 million operations per second, while LLM inference speeds for a small 135M model are average but drop to poor for a medium 7B model.

From a resource density perspective, the inclusion of a 959 GB local SSD provides a cost-efficient storage-to-compute ratio for workloads requiring fast local disk access without the overhead of network-attached storage. Given the weak single-core performance and average database operation benchmarks, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, local caching, development environments, and lightweight database applications that benefit from local SSD storage but do not demand high-frequency CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores), 32.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 959 GB local SSD, operating under a KVM hypervisor with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results show weak single-core and multi-core CPU performance, with Geekbench and stress-ng scores falling in the bottom 25%. However, the instance maintains average performance in Passmark CPU tests, large-block memory write bandwidth, and Redis SET operations. Due to its bundled local SSD storage and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.i2g.2xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-centric workloads, making it suitable for lightweight databases, local caching, and general-purpose applications that require local storage but have moderate CPU demands.
